description: This file defines a Go package 'procfs' that provides functionality to retrieve and parse filesystem cache statistics (fscache) from the Linux kernel, including a data structure 'Fscacheinfo' with numerous cache-related metrics and functions to read and parse the corresponding kernel stats file.

methods.name: Fscacheinfo
methods.description: Struct representing various fscache statistics metrics.

methods.name: FS.Fscacheinfo
methods.description: Method to read and parse the current fscache statistics from the kernel.
